findings.title: Unauthenticated /api/ip/bootstrap mutates SuperAdmin roles and schema
findings.root_cause: POST has no requireSession, cron secret, or env gate. ensureIpBootstrap can promote/demote SuperAdmin roles and run schema ensures.
findings.impact: Any anonymous caller can trigger privileged bootstrap against the shared Neon DB used by local/Vercel.
findings.remediation: Require SuperAdmin session or IP_ALLOW_BOOTSTRAP=1 / deploy secret; remove public client fire-and-forget calls from sign-in pages.

findings.title: Employer can open a message thread to any candidate userId (IDOR)
findings.snippet:
if (!isEmployer) { /* application ownership check */ }
// employers: no ownership check on otherUserId before INSERT thread
findings.root_cause: Candidate path validates application+employer; employer path accepts arbitrary otherUserId.
findings.impact: Employer may create threads to private candidates; combined with file access via thread linkage this can expose resumes.
findings.remediation: Require owned internship + application (or explicit searchable invite) before employer thread create.

findings.title: Any shared message thread authorizes candidate resume/photo via files API
findings.snippet:
return employerLinkedToCandidate(uid, id);
// SELECT 1 FROM ip_message_threads WHERE employer_user_id AND candidate_user_id
findings.root_cause: canAccessIpObject treats any thread between employer and candidate as enough for candidates/{id} objects.
findings.impact: Amplifies IP-SEC-002: thread create → resume download without application relationship.
findings.remediation: Require application ownership (or shortlist) for resume/photo; keep message attachments under messages/{threadId} only.

findings.title: Cron routes fall back to any employer session when IP_CRON_SECRET unset
findings.root_cause: Without cron secret, employer session authorizes global auto-reject / export / reminder drains.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant mass reject or job processing on shared Neon when secrets are unset.
findings.remediation: Require IP_CRON_SECRET outside local QA; session fallback SuperAdmin-only or hard-scope to caller employer.

findings.title: Google OAuth client_secret JSON present in app working tree
findings.root_cause: Confidential OAuth client JSON sits on disk (gitignored but present).
findings.impact: Filesystem/backup/zip access can steal OAuth client secret; accidental commit risk.
findings.remediation: Delete from tree; rotate secret in Google Cloud; use env vars only.

findings.title: NVIDIA NIM api_key JSON files present under nvidia_keys/
findings.root_cause: Local key files loaded by nvidiaLlm for help-chat; gitignored but on disk.
findings.impact: Credential theft / quota abuse; help-chat GET exposes localKeyFiles count publicly.
findings.remediation: Remove keys from disk; rotate; env-only on deploy hosts.

findings.title: Publish charges 50 points before stipend validation / INSERT
findings.root_cause: Points debit commits in its own transaction before later validation/INSERT.
findings.impact: Employer can lose 50 points with no posting created.
findings.remediation: Validate first; charge in same transaction as INSERT; or refund on failure.

findings.title: Application points debit is not conditional (TOCTOU overdraw)
findings.snippet:
SELECT points … if (points < 5) reject;
UPDATE ip_users SET points = points - $2 WHERE id = $1  // no points >= check
findings.root_cause: Unlike chargePublishPoints, apply debit does not use WHERE points >= cost inside the lock.
findings.impact: Concurrent applies can drive balance negative while creating applications.
findings.remediation: Debit with WHERE points >= $2 RETURNING inside the application transaction.

findings.title: Employer publish gate skips ethics / profile_complete
findings.snippet: Checks approval_status + email_verified; does not require ethics_acks or profile_complete.
findings.root_cause: Gate selects profile_complete but never enforces ethics/completion.
findings.impact: Approved employers can publish without ethics acknowledgements.
findings.remediation: Require allEthicsChecked (and optionally profile_complete) before publish/republish.

findings.title: free_post_credits granted at signup but never consumed
findings.snippet: Debits points only; free_post_credits never decremented anywhere in src/
findings.root_cause: Dead dual-currency field still defaulted to 1 on employer register.
findings.impact: Misleading inventory; signup gift is points-only (50 = one publish).
findings.remediation: Consume free credit before points, or stop writing/exposing the column.

findings.title: Help chatbot “not helpful” reason never POSTed
findings.snippet: if (!msg?.eventId || msg.feedback) return; // second call with reason early-returns
findings.root_cause: Thumbs-down sets feedback immediately; reason buttons call sendFeedback again and hit the guard.
findings.impact: Negative feedback reasons discarded; analytics wrong (also related to P2 chatbot UX).
findings.remediation: Allow reason update after not_helpful, or send reason on first request.

findings.title: Profile Field helpers use orphan <label> (no htmlFor)
findings.root_cause: Caption-only labels; controls are siblings. Same pattern on employer profile Field.
findings.impact: Screen readers may not associate names with inputs on high-traffic forms.
findings.remediation: htmlFor/id pairs or wrap controls in label.

findings.title: SearchableMultiSelect listbox lacks option roles / keyboard nav
findings.snippet: role="listbox" … options are plain buttons; Arrow/Escape not implemented
findings.impact: Keyboard/SR users cannot operate city/country multi-selects correctly.
findings.remediation: Implement combobox+listbox pattern or use a compliant component.

findings.title: Modal-like UIs claim dialog without Escape / focus trap
findings.snippet: role="dialog" aria-modal="true" — no Escape handler or focus trap (also HelpChatbot, PortalShell drawer, InternshipCandidatePreview)
findings.root_cause: Dialog semantics without focus management across multiple overlays.
findings.impact: Tab can escape to background; Escape does not dismiss.
findings.remediation: Shared focus-trap + Escape close for all modal overlays.

findings.title: npm run lint fails: no eslint.config.* for ESLint 9
findings.root_cause: eslint-config-next present but flat config file missing.
findings.impact: Lint gate cannot run in CI/local; regressions slip.

findings.title: Unauthenticated /api/ip/ops/report-error can spam ops mail
findings.snippet: POST with no session; invokes reportOpsFailure → email
findings.root_cause: Public error reporting without auth or strong rate limit.
findings.remediation: Require session or signed token; rate-limit by IP.

findings.title: Auth-sensitive IDs use Math.random newId
findings.root_cause: Non-crypto entropy used for sessions/2FA challenges/etc.
findings.impact: Weaker unpredictability vs crypto.randomBytes used for password-reset tokens.
findings.remediation: Use crypto.randomUUID / randomBytes for authz-sensitive ids.

patterns.title: Missing authn/authz gate on sensitive routes
